conflictOfInterest.details: The accountable reviewer principal is also the lesson's accountable author principal. Founding-stage policy permits one disclosed principal to operate isolated role runs, but this limits human independence and is declared explicitly.

evidenceChecked: independent recalculation of arcminute conversion, 25/35/40 cm thresholds, 94 ppd check, assessment factors, renewal rate, migration interval, and crypt diameter implied by 22 ten-micrometre cells
external primary evidence: Secretagogue response of goblet cells and columnar cells in human colonic crypts, DOI 10.1152/ajpcell.1999.277.3.C501, Table 1 crypt length and diameter

findings.finding: The ladder and its long description use the crypt's base-to-surface length of a few hundred micrometres to conclude that an unaided eye reaches a crypt opening. Length is perpendicular to the mucosal surface and is not the dimension an endoscopic or surface view must resolve. The pack's own model parameters imply an outside diameter near 70 micrometres from 22 cells around the perimeter at 10 micrometres per cell; independent human measurements likewise distinguish approximately 73.5 micrometres in diameter from 433 micrometres in length. Consequently, content/02-arithmetic-of-invisibility.md and content/07-clinical-wrap-up.md cannot infer visible crypt openings, surface spacing, or crypt density from crypt length. The clinical transfer answer therefore rewards a dimensionally invalid comparison.
findings.resolution: For every visibility claim, compare the instrument threshold with the projected dimension or separation relevant to that view. Add sourced crypt-opening diameter and lateral spacing if the surface-pattern example is retained, then recompute the verdict. Update the ladder, scene 02 retrieval answer, clinical wrap-up, and assessment.json#item-integrated-protocol-review answer and rubric wherever crypt length is currently used as proof that a surface image resolves crypts.

findings.finding: The universal definition of emergence, its two-part dissociation test, and the classification of barrier continuity, positional gradients, and renewal are central teaching claims, but claims.json contains no emergence claim and the scene's source note expressly says no source supplies the definition. The lesson then scores this convention as scientific knowledge in assessment.json#item-classify-emergence and assessment.json#item-integrated-protocol-review. Because emergence has multiple technical senses, an uncited authorial convention cannot be presented and assessed as the settled general definition.
findings.resolution: Ground the operational definition and its limits in suitable scholarly sources, add a mapped claim with support type, scope, uncertainty, and same-scene source-note coverage, and frame it explicitly as the bounded sense used in this lesson. Recheck each classified example and both assessment keys against that sourced definition.

findings.finding: The definition restricts tissue to one or a few kinds of joined cells performing a function that no cell performs alone and says that cells in suspension are no longer tissue. This excludes or misdescribes connective tissues whose extracellular matrix is constitutive, including blood with its fluid matrix and unjoined formed elements, and it incorrectly makes the lesson's emergence criterion part of the general definition of tissue. That distortion feeds directly into the cell-theory composition proposition assessed by assessment.json#item-theory-status.
findings.resolution: Replace the entry with a standard definition that includes organized cells and their extracellular material, permits tissue-specific variation in cell diversity and attachment, and does not require every tissue function to be absent from each component cell. Keep the stronger organization-and-emergence claim explicitly limited to the epithelial examples and map the revised material definition to evidence.

findings.finding: The sentence that whatever lines the colon now was not there last week is categorical, while claims.json#claim-epithelial-renewal itself records substantial cell-type variation and notes longer-lived epithelial populations. The later calculation treating all 700 crypt cells as replaced every four days likewise converts a bulk turnover interval into literal uniform replacement, despite persistent self-renewing stem-cell lineages.
findings.resolution: Limit the statement to the rapidly renewed bulk or surface absorptive compartment. Label 700 divided by four days as a simplified steady-state production estimate, not proof that every crypt cell is replaced on that schedule, and align the later renewal and observation-time wording with that boundary.

findings.finding: The statement that a lens giving ten-times magnification closes the gap attributes resolution to magnification alone. The lesson later correctly explains that magnification and resolution are distinct and that a ten-times hand lens would not reliably separate neighbouring cells, so the earlier claim is internally inconsistent with the model being taught.
findings.resolution: State that an optical system needs sufficient resolving power and enough magnification to make the resolved information visible; do not claim that ten-times magnification by itself closes the biological-resolution gap.

findings.finding: Saying that a single epithelial layer stands between colonic bacteria and the blood makes the epithelium sound like the only intervening structure. The mucus layer, basement membrane, lamina propria and vascular endothelium also intervene; the lesson itself later identifies mucus as an additional protective layer.
findings.resolution: Describe the epithelium as the principal cellular interface separating luminal contents from underlying tissue, or name the additional intervening barriers, rather than placing bacteria directly across one cell layer from blood.

limitations: Direct PMC article routes returned a reCAPTCHA interstitial in this environment. Accessible official indexed full-text extracts supported verification of the principal quantitative and historical claims, but not every cited passage could be reopened through its canonical article route.

The explicit review scope excluded site/, scripts/, workflows, and other lesson packs. Cross-lesson terminology, graph-node detail, quorum files, the review schema file, and repository validator output were therefore not independently inspected; this artifact follows the supplied academic review...

ATTRIBUTION.md itself contains a retrospective description of a prior academic finding. Reading it was unavoidable under the complete-pack requirement, but that description was not used as evidence for this verdict.

No clinical or histopathology specialist credential is claimed; the verdict is limited to the cited literature, internal calculations, established introductory cell-biology boundaries, and the declared lesson scope.
